name: Chaos Turbo
note: Chaos Turbo / Chaos Control — docs/goat-decks.md §2.3. Names validated against cards.cdb.
manual:
**Game plan:** Goat Control with the dial toward tempo; leverage DARK/LIGHT density to spam Chaos.

**Key cards / engine:** Mystic Tomato recruiter chain; Chaos Sorcerer x2 + BLS; Zaborg.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **`Mystic Tomato` fuels everything:** it dies to Special Summon a DARK (≤1500 ATK) from deck [CDB] — fetch `Sinister Serpent`, `Don Zaloog`, or another Tomato — chaining bodies while stocking DARKs in the grave for Chaos.
- **Keep a live LIGHT count** (Airknight, D.D. Warrior Lady, Magician of Faith) so `Chaos Sorcerer`/`BLS` (each needs "1 LIGHT and 1 DARK" banished [CDB]) are always online: banish their best monster, then swing.
- **`Zaborg the Thunder Monarch`** tributes a token or spent Tomato on summon to pop a monster — tempo plus a body.
- You are the beatdown in control mirrors and still hold the full trap suite vs aggro. Same Scapegoat→Metamorphosis→TER two-turn line as Goat Control for the reset.

**Weaknesses:** graveyard hate (`Kycoo`, `Soul Release`, `D.D. Warrior Lady`) shuts your Chaos off; drawing Chaos monsters with no LIGHT/DARK in grave = dead cards early.
main: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
